scenes.vo: Một người đàn ông xóa bài đăng của mình sau sáu tiếng, và mất luôn hai mươi lăm năm cuộc đời.
scenes.gloss: A man deletes his post after six hours, and loses twenty-five years of his life.
scenes.viewer: He rips his post off the town board; behind him the tournament hall's shutter slams down.
scenes.build: new: the piazza: the board with the post sheet, the bin, the civic hall with the open door and the clock; the staff with the hook pole beside the door.
scenes.blocking: Him at the tear mark (right of the sheet, facing +z); the staff at the staff mark beside the door, hook pole up at the shutter's bottom bar.
scenes.action: f0-12 he glances at the sheet; f12-17 his left arm (screen left) reaches the sheet's right edge; f17 the rip (2 f before 'xóa' f19): the sheet tears off under the pin, the top corner stays pinned; f18-30 he crumples it into a ball; f32-48 he tosses it left into the bin (arc, lands f48, the bin rocks); f92 the staff hooks the shutter's bar and pulls: the shutter rattles down f100-136 and slams on 'đời' f137 (dust puff at the sill); he turns his head to it, shocked.
scenes.acting: Him: stern -> shock on the slam. Staff: neutral.

cams.why: him tearing the post off the board
pull back: the board and the hall's shutter coming down

marks.pose: reach f12, rip f17, crumple, toss f32-48

scenes.physics: the paper ball: ballistic arc from his hand into the bin (lands f48), the bin rocks ±3 deg twice. Shutter: falls under the pole's pull, the last 0.4 m in free fall, 2 small bounces.
scenes.light_mood: bright noon sun on cream stucco.
scenes.sound: paper rip f17; crumple; a tin 'tunk' f48; the shutter's rattle f100-136 and a heavy slam f137 (a bass hit); the score's first note.
scenes.after: The torn corner stays on the pin; the paper ball stays in the bin.

scenes.vo: Anh là Alessandro Cremascoli, biệt danh iCaterpie, người Ý, hai lần vô địch quốc gia môn thẻ bài Pokémon.
scenes.gloss: He is Alessandro Cremascoli, nicknamed iCaterpie, Italian, twice national champion of the Pokémon card game.
scenes.viewer: At his café table: the name, the Caterpie card held up, two national trophies.
scenes.build: reuse the café terrace (T1): two gold trophies (plates VÔ ĐỊCH QUỐC GIA), an espresso, his deck box; bunting overhead.
scenes.blocking: Him seated at T1 (him_t1), facing +z, head toward the lens.
scenes.action: f150-230 he sips the espresso (cup to mouth f190-205); f236-248 his right arm lifts the real Caterpie card toward the lens on 'iCaterpie' (f250): it fills ~45% of the frame width f252-300; f300-330 the camera pulls back to the two trophies on 'hai lần' (f301); a gleam crosses each trophy f306 and f314.
scenes.acting: Him: smile, a proud grin on the card.

cams.why: him at his café table
the Caterpie card fills the frame
the two trophies

scenes.light_mood: warm sun under the striped awning.
scenes.sound: café murmur, a cup clink f205; a bright pluck motif; a 'ting' per trophy gleam.
scenes.after: The card back in his deck box.

scenes.vo: Hai mươi lăm năm, anh đi khắp nước Ý dạy người lạ cách chơi, dựng nên cả một cộng đồng.
scenes.gloss: For twenty-five years he travelled all over Italy teaching strangers how to play, building a whole community.
scenes.viewer: His suitcase covered in city stickers; he teaches a stranger; the camera pulls back on a terrace full of players.
scenes.build: reuse the terrace; the sticker suitcase (ROMA, NAPOLI, TORINO, VENEZIA, MILANO, BOLOGNA, FIRENZE); the stranger at T1; four players at T2 and T3 with real cards.
scenes.blocking: Him walks in from the right with the suitcase past the signpost to T1; the stranger already seated at str_t1; players at T2/T3 (off frame until the pull back).
scenes.action: f372-446 he wheels the suitcase from (5.6, -1.4) left past the signpost to T1 (stickers readable); f446-452 parks it and sits; f458-474 he lays a real card on the table in front of the stranger ('dạy' f451), points at it f475; the stranger nods f480; f488-535 the camera rises and pulls back: T2 and T3 full of players ('cộng đồng' f521).
scenes.acting: Him: friendly, explaining. Stranger: puzzled -> smile.

cams.why: him and the sticker suitcase
teaching the stranger
pull back: the terrace full of players

marks.pose: walks f372-446, sits f452, lays a card f458-474

scenes.sound: suitcase wheels on cobbles; card snap f474; the community grows: more voices, laughter f500-535.

scenes.vo: Hơn một tháng sau giải vô địch thế giới ở San Francisco,
scenes.gloss: More than a month after the World Championships in San Francisco,
scenes.viewer: Worlds in San Francisco: the Golden Gate in the window; a judge rules at his table.
scenes.build: new: the Worlds hall, the window wall with the Golden Gate, table A, back tables.
scenes.blocking: Him seated at the left end (facing the opponent), the opponent at the right end, the judge standing behind the table.
scenes.action: f540-575 cards played (one slides onto his mat f560); f586-600 the judge raises his right arm (a ruling); f600 he frowns, arms folded; f612 the judge points at his mat; f625 he throws up his hands.
scenes.acting: Judge: stern. Him: stern -> annoyed. Opponent: nervous.

cams.why: the hall and the Golden Gate
the table, the judge

marks.pose: plays; folds arms f600; hands up f625

scenes.light_mood: bright hall, sun through the window.
scenes.sound: hall hubbub, a card slide f560, a judge's whistle-free 'tsk'; shuffle sounds.

scenes.vo: anh lên mạng viết một bài than phiền về một trọng tài ở giải đó.
scenes.gloss: he went online and wrote a post complaining about a judge at that event.
scenes.viewer: He pins a sheet on the town board and writes his complaint, a striped-shirt judge doodle on top.
scenes.build: reuse the board (no sheet before f656); the shutter open; passers-by in the back.
scenes.blocking: Him walks in from the right carrying the blank sheet to the tear mark.
scenes.action: f640-654 he walks in with the blank sheet (held at the chest); f656-660 he pins it (pin pressed f660); f662-735 he writes with a marker: the judge doodle on 'trọng tài' (f703-716), complaint lines (each line ~10 f, the marker squeaks).

cams.why: the board, him arriving
the writing

marks.pose: walks in f640-654, pins f660, writes f662-735

scenes.physics: the sheet hangs from one pin (a slight sway after pinning).
scenes.sound: a pin thunk f660; marker squeaks f662-735; distant scooter.
scenes.after: The sheet hangs on the board, written.

scenes.vo: Và anh gọi thẳng tên người ấy.
scenes.gloss: And he called that person out by name.
scenes.viewer: He writes the judge's name in red; a black censor bar slams over it.
scenes.build: reuse the sheet: the name line at its bottom.
scenes.blocking: Him at the tear mark, his arm at the sheet.
scenes.action: f745-768 his marker writes the name in big red letters (we never see it legibly: scribble shapes); f766-772 he steps aside to the right; f772 a black censor bar slams over it (2 f squash) on 'tên' (f774); he looks at it, satisfied.

cams.why: the name on the sheet, him writing it

scenes.after: The name under the censor bar.

scenes.vo: Sáu tiếng sau, anh xóa bài.
scenes.gloss: Six hours later, he deleted the post.
scenes.viewer: The clock spins six hours while the town streams past the post and photographs it; then he tears it down.
scenes.build: reuse the master wide: the clock, the open door, the board with the sheet.
scenes.blocking: Passers-by stream left-right in front of the board (time-lapse); him back at the tear mark from f832.
scenes.action: f800-836 the clock's hands spin from 13:00 to 19:00 (the minute hand six turns); five passers-by cross fast, three stop and raise phones: flashes f806, f815, f824; f832 he steps back to the board; f841 he rips the sheet off (2 f before 'xóa' f843); the corner stays.

cams.why: the clock, the board and the town: six hours

scenes.sound: a fast clock tick-whirr f800-836; Camera shutter (meme) x3; the rip f841.
scenes.after: Only the torn corner on the pin.

scenes.vo: Ngày mười sáu tháng mười, khi đang chuẩn bị lên đường dự giải ở Nice, anh báo tin: mình đã bị cấm vĩnh viễn khỏi mọi giải đấu chính thức của Pokémon.
scenes.gloss: On October 16, as he was getting ready to travel to the event in Nice, he announced: he had been permanently banned from all official Pokémon events.
scenes.viewer: With his NICE-tagged suitcase he pins his announcement; the staff slam the hall's shutter, padlock it and hang CẤM VĨNH VIỄN.
scenes.build: reuse the piazza; the suitcase with a NICE luggage tag; the announcement sheet; the padlock and the sign.
scenes.blocking: Him wheels the suitcase in from the right to the tear mark; the staff at the door.
scenes.action: f862-930 he wheels the suitcase from (1.9, -2.3) to the tear mark; f945-962 the NICE tag swings on the handle ('Nice' f958); f975-995 he takes the announcement from his jacket and pins it (pin f998, 'báo tin' f982-988); f1003-1020 the staff pulls the shutter down, it slams on 'cấm' f1022; f1030-1036 the staff snaps the padlock shut ('vĩnh viễn' f1036); f1044-1058 he hangs the sign CẤM VĨNH VIỄN on the shutter's hasp; f1062-1095 the camera rises to the sign above the door: POKÉMON · GIẢI ĐẤU CHÍNH THỨC.
scenes.acting: Him: tired, sad. Staff: neutral, businesslike.

cams.why: him and the suitcase crossing to the board
the NICE tag, the announcement pinned
the shutter slams
the padlock, the sign
the sign over the shut door

scenes.physics: the luggage tag: pendulum on its strap; the shutter as in S01; the padlock shackle snaps 1 cm.
scenes.sound: suitcase wheels; a pin thunk f998; the shutter rattle and slam f1022 (bass hit); the padlock click f1036; the sign's chain jingle f1050.
scenes.after: The shutter stays down, padlocked, the sign on it, until the end.

scenes.vo: "Tôi suy sụp. Pokémon đúng nghĩa là cuộc đời tôi. Tôi không thể ngừng khóc."
scenes.gloss: "I'm devastated. Pokémon is literally my life. I can't stop crying."
scenes.viewer: He slumps onto his suitcase before the shut door, looks at his Caterpie card, and cries.
scenes.build: reuse; the suitcase moved to the sit mark (he wheels it there f1100-1110, off camera during the glide).
scenes.blocking: Him seated on the suitcase at the sit mark, the shut door behind him.
scenes.action: f1110-1128 he slumps down onto the suitcase ('suy sụp' f1120); f1147-1160 he takes the Caterpie card out and holds it in front of him, head bowed to it ('cuộc đời tôi' f1186-1199); f1212-1252 tears drip from his eyes onto the cobbles (a drop every 6 f each side), small dark dots stay.

cams.why: him on the suitcase, the padlocked door behind
the card in his hands, his face
the tears, the door behind

scenes.physics: tear drops fall under gravity from the eyes to the cobbles.
scenes.sound: a soft piano line (synth), no meme; a quiet sniff f1215.

scenes.vo: Khoan đã, bài đã xóa rồi mà vẫn bị phạt?
scenes.gloss: Wait, the post was deleted and he was still punished?
scenes.viewer: His friend stares at the torn corner on the board and shrugs.
scenes.build: reuse the board: the torn corner, the announcement.
scenes.blocking: Friend standing in front of the board at (-1.1, -1.3), facing +z.
scenes.action: f1258 Huh; f1262-1290 the friend points back at the torn corner; f1300-1325 scratches his head; f1334 shrugs on 'phạt?'.

cams.why: the friend and the torn corner

marks.pose: points f1262; scratches f1300; shrugs f1334

scenes.vo: Hóa ra, trên mạng, nút xóa chỉ xóa được trên màn hình của bạn.
scenes.gloss: It turns out that online, the delete button only deletes from your own screen.
scenes.viewer: From the friend's eyes: on his phone, the full post (a photo); behind the phone, the bare board.
scenes.build: the friend's phone (canvas: PHOTOS, the photo of the sheet with the censored name, 13:42).
scenes.blocking: Camera at the friend's eyes; the phone in his hands in front.
scenes.action: f1350-1390 he swipes through three photos of the sheet (each a different angle: they're other people's shares); f1394 'nút xóa': the thumbnail strip shows 37 copies; f1440-1470 the phone tilts a little toward the board: the photo's sheet lines up with the torn corner.

cams.why: the phone, the bare board behind

scenes.sound: swipe whooshes; a soft phone tap.

scenes.vo: Bài đăng giống như ly nước đổ ra sàn: bạn lau được vũng nước, nhưng người khác đã kịp nhìn thấy đôi giày ướt.
scenes.gloss: A post is like a glass of water spilled on the floor: you can mop up the puddle, but others have already seen the wet shoes.
scenes.viewer: He knocks over a glass, mops the puddle clean, but the friend who walked through it leaves a trail of wet prints, and the café patrons point.
scenes.build: reuse the terrace T1/T2: a tall water glass, a napkin; the patrons at T2.
scenes.blocking: Him seated at T1; the friend walks across the terrace right to left; two patrons seated at T2.
scenes.action: f1500-1506 his right arm gestures and knocks the glass ('ly nước' f1508); it tips off the near edge and falls (rigid body), hits the cobbles f1519 ('đổ' f1519): a splash, a puddle spreads to r 0.32 m by f1530; the glass rolls and rests; f1522-1546 the friend walks in along the café front and steps in the puddle (f1533), then turns toward the lens; f1548-1556 he stands, f1558-1584 crouches and wipes with the napkin: the puddle shrinks to nothing ('lau' f1558); f1584-1650 the wet prints the friend left run from the puddle toward the lens to where he stands (a trail down the frame); the patrons look down at the prints, then point at his dripping legs ('nhìn thấy' f1627, 'giày ướt' f1641).
scenes.acting: Him: oops -> relieved (puddle gone) -> nervous. Friend: oblivious -> embarrassed. Patrons: grin, pointing.

cams.why: the table, the glass, the terrace
the wet prints to the friend, the patrons pointing

scenes.physics: the glass: cannon-es cylinder, tipped from the table edge, 240 Hz bake; the splash a 6 f FX; the puddle a flat decal that grows then shrinks under the napkin; prints a fading decal per step.
scenes.sound: glass knock f1506, a clink-splash f1519; footsteps; squeaky napkin f1558-1584; a wet squelch per step; patrons' giggle.
scenes.after: A dry spot where the puddle was; the wet prints fade by f1660.

scenes.vo: Sáu tiếng, đủ để bất kỳ ai chụp lại.
scenes.gloss: Six hours is enough for anyone to take a picture.
scenes.viewer: From the post's own view on the board: five people raise their phones and flash.
scenes.build: reuse the piazza looking +z from the board's face: the crowd, the house fronts, the fountain.
scenes.blocking: Five passers-by in front of the board (z -1.5..-0.2), facing the board (the lens), phones held up, screens to them.
scenes.action: f1662-1700 they gather; flashes from their phones at f1702, f1712, f1718, f1723, f1729 ('chụp lại' f1723).

cams.why: the post's view: the crowd snapping it

scenes.vo: Cộng đồng chia làm hai phe. Một bên nói, cấm cả đời là quá nặng.
scenes.gloss: The community split into two camps. One side says a lifetime ban is too heavy.
scenes.viewer: The crowd splits to the two pans of a public scale; the near side drops the CẤM CẢ ĐỜI weight on its pan and it slams down.
scenes.build: reuse; the scale stands at (-3.2, 1.0); the two iron weights on the cobbles by the pans.
scenes.blocking: Six people in a group beside the scale; three walk to the near pan, three to the far pan.
scenes.action: f1740-1778 the group splits (three walk toward the lens, three away); f1800-1838 two of the near side lift the CẤM CẢ ĐỜI weight (both arms) and drop it on the near pan f1840; f1845 ('quá nặng') the pan slams to the ground, the beam tilts hard; the far pan rises; they throw up their arms.
scenes.acting: Near side: indignant. Far side: arms folded.

cams.why: the crowd by the scale
the near pan and the heavy weight

scenes.physics: the beam: a damped pendulum about the pivot; the weight lands with no bounce (iron), the pan hits the ground stop.
scenes.sound: footsteps; a grunt on the lift; a heavy CLANG f1845 (Instagram Thud under it).
scenes.after: The near pan on the ground.

scenes.vo: Bên kia nói, lẽ ra anh không nên nêu tên trọng tài trên mạng.
scenes.gloss: The other side says he should never have named the judge online.
scenes.viewer: The far side puts NÊU TÊN TRỌNG TÀI on their pan and the beam swings back to level.
scenes.blocking: Far side at the far pan.
scenes.action: f1880-1922 two of the far side lift their weight; f1925 it lands on the far pan; f1928-1960 the beam swings back to level, overshoots once and settles; both sides glare at each other f1960-1974.
scenes.acting: Far side: stern. Near side: annoyed.

cams.why: the far side and their weight
the scale level, the two camps

scenes.physics: beam: damped pendulum back to level (period 1.1 s, damping 0.35).
scenes.sound: a second clang f1925; a creak as the beam rises.
scenes.after: The scale level, both weights on it.

scenes.vo: Còn The Pokémon Company, đến giờ vẫn chưa nói một lời nào.
scenes.gloss: And The Pokémon Company, to this day, has not said a single word.
scenes.viewer: The official frame at the top of the board stays empty; a crow lands on it and caws.
scenes.build: reuse the board: the empty official frame THE POKÉMON COMPANY · THÔNG BÁO CHÍNH THỨC.
scenes.action: f1974-2040 slow push on the empty frame; f2030-2048 a crow flies in from the right and lands on the frame's top edge ('chưa nói' f2048); f2058 it caws; it cocks its head.

cams.why: the empty official frame

scenes.physics: the crow: flap-glide in, a 2 f squash on landing.
scenes.sound: silence under the VO (the score drops out); Crow (meme) f2058.

scenes.vo: Nên mọi lý do ta biết, đều chỉ là lời kể của anh.
scenes.gloss: So every reason we know is only his own account.
scenes.viewer: Down the board to his announcement: the only source, signed iCaterpie.
scenes.action: f2089-2130 the camera glides down from the empty frame to his sheet; f2150-2175 a slow push to the signature '— iCaterpie' ('lời kể của anh' f2155-2173).

cams.why: his announcement, the only source

scenes.vo: Bài đăng ấy sống được sáu tiếng.
scenes.viewer: The torn corner on its pin, then up to the clock.
scenes.action: f2185-2208 the torn corner (a breeze flutters it); f2208-2240 tilt up to the clock: its hands sweep 13:00 -> 19:00 once more ('sáu tiếng' f2222).

cams.why: the torn corner
the clock: six hours

scenes.vo: Còn lệnh cấm, theo lời anh, là mãi mãi.
scenes.gloss: And the ban, by his account, is forever.
scenes.viewer: Pull back to the whole square: the padlocked door, him on his suitcase, the clock spinning on and on.
scenes.build: reuse the master wide; the scale with both weights at the left edge.
scenes.blocking: Him seated on the suitcase at the sit mark.
scenes.action: f2243-2300 the camera pulls back and down to the master wide; the clock's hands spin faster and faster (days go by) from f2260 ('mãi mãi' f2311-2330); the clouds drift; he stays sitting; the sign sways once.

cams.why: the square: the shut door, him, the clock forever

scenes.sound: the theme's last phrase, a clock tick that speeds up and fades.
